== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Stormtrooper (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Stormtrooper]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/stormtrooper_japanese_white_border/50651 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/c37c9d59090e4cf583bd8e8ec67868bc/IMG_20240101_0006.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(6, 6, 646, 1018)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>34057c8a7de85c082cc6baf20be1404ab54705c07ce0e4313539760bd34f8319</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
